evidence: The Hf–Y–O ﬁlms were deposited by ALD in a hot wall cross flow reactor using hafnium chloride (HfCl 4) and tris(methylcyclopentadienyl)yttrium (Cp(CH 3)3Y) as metal precursors. Water vapour and argon were used as the oxygen source and purge gas, respectively. Films were deposited from 260 up to 420 /C176C under vacuum at total pressure of 65 Pa onto (1 0 0)-Si with a size of 25 /C225 mm2.
